Description.en_US: A district that provides this city with a source of fresh water from an adjacent River, Lake, Oasis, or Mountain. Cities that do not yet have existing fresh water receive up to 6 [ICON_Housing] Housing. Cities that already have existing fresh water will instead get +2 [ICON_Housing] Housing. If built adjacent to a Geothermal Fissure +1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity. Prevents [ICON_Food] Food loss during Drought. Must be built adjacent to the City Center. Military Engineers can spend a charge to complete 20% of an Aqueduct's production.

Description.en_US: A district built on flat land to connect two bodies of water or a body of water to a City Center. [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Routes traveling through it can multiply the [ICON_Gold] Gold they get from districts at their destination. Canals may either go straight through the hex or bend by 60 degrees. However three-way Canal junctures are not allowed and Canals must have a full land tile on each side of the waterway they create. Military Engineers can spend a charge to complete 20% of a Canal's production.
Description.zh_Hans_CN: 建在平原上的区域，连接两块水域单元格或将一块水域单元格与市中心连接。如 [ICON_TradeRoute] 贸易路线途径此处，其将从目的地的区域处获得成倍 [ICON_Gold] 金币。运河可笔直穿过单元格，也可在其中进行60度转向。无法建造三向连接运河，且运河在其所建水路的两侧皆必须含有一个完整的陆地单元格。军事工程师可消耗1次使用次数来完成运河20%的修建进度。
